title: The Book of Galatians Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Galatians — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
verses.decoded: I am Paul, an apostle—not appointed by any human authority, nor through a human, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Jesus from the dead.

verses.kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
verses.decoded: Along with all the brothers and sisters who are with me, I am writing to the churches in Galatia.

verses.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.decoded: May grace and peace be given to you from God the Father and from our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
verses.decoded: Jesus gave himself for our sins to rescue us from this evil world, following the will of God our Father.

verses.kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: To him be glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
verses.decoded: I am amazed that you are so quickly turning away from the one who called you by the grace of Christ to follow a different gospel.

verses.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
verses.decoded: But there is no other gospel; some people are confusing you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.

verses.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
verses.decoded: Even if we or an angel from heaven preach a gospel different from the one we preached to you, let that person be condemned.

verses.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
verses.decoded: As I said before, I say again: If anyone preaches a gospel different from what you received, let them be condemned.

verses.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
verses.decoded: Am I trying to please people or God? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

verses.kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that the gospel I preach did not come from any human source.

verses.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: I did not receive it from any person, nor was I taught it; instead, I received it through a revelation from Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
verses.decoded: You have heard about my past life in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God violently and tried to destroy it.

verses.kjv: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
verses.decoded: I was more successful in Judaism than most people my age in my own nation, and I was extremely zealous for the traditions of my ancestors.

verses.kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,
verses.decoded: But when God, who set me apart from birth, was pleased to call me by his grace,

verses.kjv: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
verses.decoded: God revealed His Son to me so that I could preach Him to the Gentiles. Right away, I did not consult with any human beings.

verses.kjv: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
verses.decoded: I did not go to Jerusalem to meet the apostles who were there before me. Instead, I went into Arabia and then returned to Damascus.

verses.kjv: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
verses.decoded: After three years, I went to Jerusalem to meet Peter and stayed with him for fifteen days.

verses.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.
verses.decoded: I did not see any other apostles except James, who is the Lord’s brother.

verses.kjv: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
verses.decoded: What I am writing to you is true, and I am not lying before God.

verses.kjv: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
verses.decoded: Later, I traveled through the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

verses.kjv: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judæa which were in Christ:
verses.decoded: The churches in Judea that belong to Christ did not personally know me.

verses.kjv: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
verses.decoded: But they had only heard that the one who once persecuted us is now preaching the very faith he tried to destroy.

verses.kjv: And they glorified God in me.
verses.decoded: And they praised God because of me.

verses.kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
verses.decoded: Fourteen years later, I went back to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and I also took Titus with me.

verses.kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
verses.decoded: I went up because God revealed it to me, and I explained to those respected leaders the gospel I preach to the Gentiles, but I spoke to them privately so that I wouldn't be running or have run in vain.

verses.kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
verses.decoded: But Titus, who was with me and was a Greek, was not forced to be circumcised.

verses.kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
verses.decoded: This was because some false brothers secretly came in to spy on the freedom we have in Christ Jesus, hoping to make us slaves again.

verses.kjv: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
verses.decoded: We did not give in to them even for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.

verses.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
verses.decoded: As for those who seemed important—whatever they were doesn't matter to me, because God doesn't show favoritism—they added nothing to what I preach.

verses.kjv: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
verses.decoded: Instead, when they saw that I was entrusted with the gospel for the Gentiles, just as Peter was entrusted with the gospel for the Jews,

verses.kjv: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
verses.decoded: God, who empowered Peter to be an apostle to the Jews, also empowered me to be an apostle to the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
verses.decoded: When James, Peter, and John—who were considered leaders—recognized the grace given to me, they welcomed Barnabas and me as partners, agreeing that we would go to the Gentiles and they to the Jews.

verses.kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
verses.decoded: They only asked that we remember the poor, which I was eager to do as well.

verses.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
verses.decoded: But when Peter came to Antioch, I openly confronted him because he was clearly wrong.

verses.kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
verses.decoded: Before some people came from James, Peter ate with Gentiles; but when they arrived, he pulled back and separated himself, afraid of those who insisted on circumcision.

verses.kjv: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
verses.decoded: The other Jewish believers acted the same way, so much so that even Barnabas was led astray by their hypocrisy.

verses.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
verses.decoded: When I saw they were not living honestly according to the gospel, I said to Peter in front of everyone, 'If you, a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, why do you force Gentiles to live like Jews?'

verses.kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
verses.decoded: We who are Jews by birth and not Gentile sinners,

verses.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
verses.decoded: We understand that no one is made right with God by following the law, but only through faith in Jesus Christ. We have believed in Jesus Christ so that we might be made right through faith in Him, not by obeying the law, because no one will be made right by following the law.

verses.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
verses.decoded: If we try to be made right with God through Christ but are still sinners, does that mean Christ encourages sin? Absolutely not!

verses.kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
verses.decoded: If I start following the old law again after having rejected it, I would be breaking God's law myself.

verses.kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
verses.decoded: Because of the law, I have died to the law itself so that I can live for God.

verses.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
verses.decoded: I have been united with Christ in His death, but I still live. However, it’s not really me living; Christ lives in me. The life I now live in my body, I live by trusting in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself for me.

verses.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
verses.decoded: I do not reject God's grace, because if being right with God could come through the law, then Christ died for nothing.

verses.kjv: O FOOLISH Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verses.decoded: You foolish Galatians! Who has tricked you so that you no longer obey the truth? You saw Jesus Christ clearly shown to you, crucified among you.

verses.kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.decoded: I want to know one thing from you: Did you receive the Holy Spirit by following the law, or by believing what you heard?

verses.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
verses.decoded: Are you really so foolish? You started by the Spirit, so are you now trying to become perfect by human effort?

verses.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
verses.decoded: Have you endured so much for nothing? If it really was for nothing.

verses.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.decoded: The one who gives you the Spirit and performs miracles among you—does he do it by following the law, or by your believing what you heard?

verses.kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
verses.decoded: Just as Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

verses.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
verses.decoded: Understand then that those who have faith are children of Abraham.

verses.kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
verses.decoded: The Scripture anticipated that God would make the Gentiles right with Him through faith, and it announced this good news to Abraham in advance: 'All nations will be blessed through you.'

verses.kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
verses.decoded: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, who had faith.

verses.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
verses.decoded: All who rely on following the law are under a curse, because it is written: 'Cursed is everyone who does not obey everything written in the law.'

verses.kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
verses.decoded: It is clear that no one is made right with God by the law, because the righteous will live by faith.

verses.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
verses.decoded: The law is not based on faith; instead, it says, 'The person who obeys the law will live by it.'

verses.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.decoded: Christ has freed us from the law’s curse by becoming a curse for us—because it is written, 'Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.'

verses.kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.decoded: This was so that the blessing given to Abraham would come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, and we would receive the promised Holy Spirit by faith.

verses.kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I am speaking in human terms: Even though a covenant is just a human agreement, once it is confirmed, no one can cancel it or add to it.

verses.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
verses.decoded: The promises were made to Abraham and his one descendant. It does not say 'descendants' as many, but 'descendant,' meaning Christ.

verses.kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
verses.decoded: I mean this: The covenant God made with Abraham, which was confirmed in Christ, was established long before the law came 430 years later. The law cannot cancel that covenant and make God's promise useless.

verses.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
verses.decoded: If the inheritance depended on the law, it would no longer be based on a promise. But God gave it to Abraham by a promise.

verses.kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
verses.decoded: So what is the purpose of the law? It was added because of wrongdoing, until the promised descendant came. The law was given through angels, with a mediator.

verses.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
verses.decoded: A mediator works between two parties, but God is one.

verses.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
verses.decoded: Does this mean the law opposes God's promises? Absolutely not! If the law could give life, then people would be made right with God by following the law.

verses.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
verses.decoded: But Scripture has shown that everyone is under sin, so that the promise given through faith in Jesus Christ can be received by those who believe.

verses.kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.decoded: Before faith in Christ came, we were held under the law, locked up until the faith that was to come would be revealed.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
verses.decoded: So the law was like a teacher that led us to Christ, so that we could be made right with God through faith.

verses.kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
verses.decoded: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under the law as our teacher.

verses.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: For all of you who have faith in Christ Jesus are children of God.

verses.kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
verses.decoded: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

verses.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: There is no difference between Jew or Greek, slave or free, male or female, because you are all one in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.decoded: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham's descendants and heirs according to God's promise.

verses.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
verses.decoded: I mean that as long as an heir is still a child, he is no different from a servant, even though he owns everything.

verses.kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
verses.decoded: He is under guardians and managers until the father decides the right time.

verses.kjv: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
verses.decoded: In the same way, when we were spiritually immature, we were enslaved by the basic principles of the world.

verses.kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verses.decoded: But when the right time came, God sent his Son, born of a woman and subject to the law,

verses.kjv: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
verses.decoded: To free those who were under the law so that we could be accepted as God’s children.

verses.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.decoded: Because you are God’s children, he has sent the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, and we now call God ‘Father.’

verses.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
verses.decoded: So you are no longer a servant but a child; and as a child, you are also an heir of God through Christ.

verses.kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
verses.decoded: But back then, when you didn’t know God, you served things that are not really gods by nature.

verses.kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
verses.decoded: But now that you know God—or rather, God knows you—why are you turning back to those weak and worthless basic rules you want to be enslaved by again?

verses.kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
verses.decoded: You are carefully observing special days, months, seasons, and years.

verses.kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
verses.decoded: I’m worried about you because I fear my work among you may have been wasted.

verses.kjv: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, I urge you to be like me, because I am like you. You haven’t harmed me at all.

verses.kjv: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
verses.decoded: You know that when I first preached the gospel to you, I was physically weak.

verses.kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: You didn’t reject me because of my physical weakness; instead, you welcomed me like an angel from God, even like Christ Jesus himself.

verses.kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
verses.decoded: So where is the happiness you once talked about? I’m sure that if it had been possible, you would have even given me your own eyes.

verses.kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
verses.decoded: Have I become your enemy just because I am honest with you?

verses.kjv: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
verses.decoded: Some people are eager to influence you, but not for your good. In fact, they want to push you away so that you will focus on them instead.

verses.kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.decoded: It’s good to be passionate about doing what is right, not just when I am with you, but all the time.

verses.kjv: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
verses.decoded: My dear children, I am going through the pain of childbirth again until Christ is fully developed in you.

verses.kjv: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
verses.decoded: I want to be with you now and speak more clearly, because I am worried and confused about your behavior.

verses.kjv: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
verses.decoded: Tell me, those of you who want to follow the law, don’t you understand what the law says?

verses.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
verses.decoded: The scripture says Abraham had two sons—one born to a slave woman and the other to a free woman.

verses.kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
verses.decoded: The son born to the slave woman was born naturally, but the son born to the free woman was born because of God’s promise.

verses.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
verses.decoded: This story is an allegory: the two women represent two covenants. One comes from Mount Sinai and leads to slavery—that is Hagar.

verses.kjv: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
verses.decoded: Hagar represents Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present city of Jerusalem, which is in slavery with her children.

verses.kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.decoded: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is the mother of all of us.

verses.kjv: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
verses.decoded: As it says, rejoice, you barren woman who has no children; shout for joy, you who have never given birth, because the woman who is left alone has more children than the one with a husband.

verses.kjv: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
verses.decoded: So, brothers and sisters, like Isaac, we are children born because of God’s promise.

verses.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
verses.decoded: But just as the son born naturally persecuted the son born by the Spirit, it is the same now.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
verses.decoded: But what does the scripture say? Throw out the slave woman and her son, because the son of the slave woman will never share the inheritance with the son of the free woman.

verses.kjv: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
verses.decoded: So, brothers and sisters, we are not like children born to a slave woman, but like children born to a free woman.

verses.kjv: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.decoded: So, continue firmly in the freedom Christ has given us, and don’t get trapped again under the burden of slavery.

verses.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
verses.decoded: Listen, I Paul tell you, if you choose to be circumcised, Christ won’t help you at all.

verses.kjv: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.decoded: I repeat to everyone who is circumcised: you are obligated to obey the entire law.

verses.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
verses.decoded: If you try to be made right with God by the law, Christ’s sacrifice means nothing to you, and you have turned away from God’s grace.

verses.kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.decoded: But through the Spirit, we eagerly await the hope of being made right with God through faith.

verses.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
verses.decoded: In Jesus Christ, it doesn’t matter whether you are circumcised or not; what counts is faith expressing itself through love.

verses.kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
verses.decoded: You were doing so well; who has stopped you from following the truth?

verses.kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
verses.decoded: This teaching does not come from the one who called you.

verses.kjv: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.decoded: A small amount of yeast affects the whole batch of dough.

verses.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.decoded: I am confident in the Lord that you will not think differently, but whoever is causing trouble will face judgment, no matter who they are.

verses.kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
verses.decoded: Brothers, if I were still preaching circumcision, why would I still be persecuted? The offense of the cross would be gone.

verses.kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
verses.decoded: I wish those who are causing you trouble would be completely removed.

verses.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, you were called to be free, but don’t use your freedom as an excuse to satisfy selfish desires; instead, serve each other with love.

verses.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.decoded: The entire law is fulfilled by this one command: Love your neighbor as yourself.

verses.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
verses.decoded: But if you keep attacking and hurting each other, be careful or you will destroy each other.

verses.kjv: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.decoded: So I say, live by the Spirit, and you will not follow your sinful desires.

verses.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
verses.decoded: Our sinful nature desires what the Spirit opposes, and the Spirit opposes what the flesh desires. They are in conflict, so you can’t always do what you want.

verses.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
verses.decoded: But if the Spirit leads you, you are not controlled by the law.

verses.kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.decoded: The sinful actions are clear: sexual immorality, impurity, and indecency,

verses.kjv: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.decoded: idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, fighting, jealousy, anger, selfish ambition, divisions, and false teachings,

verses.kjv: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: envy, murder, drunkenness, wild parties, and things like these. I warn you again, as I did before, that those who live like this will not inherit God’s kingdom.

verses.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.decoded: But the Spirit produces love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, and faithfulness.

verses.kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.decoded: Gentleness and self-control. There is no law against these qualities.

verses.kjv: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
verses.decoded: Those who belong to Christ have put to death their sinful nature with its desires and passions.

verses.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.decoded: If we are guided by the Spirit, we should also live our lives following the Spirit.

verses.kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.decoded: Let’s not be proud or try to make others angry or jealous.

verses.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught doing wrong, those of you who are spiritually mature should gently help them get back on the right path, being careful not to fall into temptation yourselves.

verses.kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
verses.decoded: Help carry each other's troubles, and in doing so, you will be living out Christ’s command to love one another.

verses.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.decoded: If anyone thinks they are important when they really are not, they are fooling themselves.

verses.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.decoded: Each person should examine their own actions, so they can be proud of what they have done, not comparing themselves to others.

verses.kjv: For every man shall bear his own burden.
verses.decoded: Everyone will be responsible for their own duties and challenges.

verses.kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
verses.decoded: Those who receive teaching from God’s word should share their blessings with the teachers.

verses.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
verses.decoded: Don’t be fooled; God cannot be tricked. Whatever a person plants, they will also harvest.

verses.kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
verses.decoded: If you live only to satisfy your sinful nature, you will face destruction; but if you live by following the Spirit, you will receive eternal life.

verses.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.decoded: Let’s not get tired of doing good, because if we keep going, we will receive a reward at the right time.

verses.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.decoded: Whenever we have the chance, let’s do good to everyone, but especially to fellow believers.

verses.kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verses.decoded: You can see how long this letter is, which I have personally written to you.

verses.kjv: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
verses.decoded: Those who want to look good outwardly are forcing you to be circumcised, but really it’s to avoid being persecuted for following Christ.

verses.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.decoded: Even those who insist on circumcision don’t fully obey the law themselves; they just want you circumcised so they can boast about you.

verses.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verses.decoded: I refuse to boast about anything except the cross of Jesus Christ, through which the world’s values have lost their hold on me, and I have lost my hold on the world.

verses.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.decoded: In Christ, it doesn’t matter whether you are circumcised or not; what matters is becoming a new person.

verses.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
verses.decoded: Peace and mercy be upon all who live by this principle, and also upon the people of God.

verses.kjv: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
verses.decoded: From now on, let no one cause me trouble, because I carry the scars of Jesus on my body.

verses.kjv: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
verses.decoded: Brothers and sisters, may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen. (Written to the Galatians from Rome.)
